svg.title: Exa Search: excerpts first, full pages on request
svg.desc: The model calls tools added by ExaSearch. web_search calls Exa search and returns the top five hits with title, URL and excerpts; get_page calls Exa get_contents for one URL, capped at 10,000 characters; the opt-in deep_search calls Exa search with type deep and returns one cited answer. The separate ExaAgent capability adds exa_agent, which creates an Exa Agent run and defers until it completes. Every tool returns a ToolReturn: the text goes to the model and the sources entry of its metadata holds ExaSource records for your app.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
